texts: 6X Complimentary Airport Lounge Access
Complimentary access to Plaza Premium Lounge and UOB Private Lounge at KLIA Terminal 1.
6X complimentary lounge access per calendar year for principal cardmember.
Exclusive private lounge access at KLIA Terminal 1 Plaza Premium Lounge.
Only 1 admission per day, subject to availability at the Plaza Premium Lounge.

Applicable charges will be charged to the UOB Lady’s Solitaire Principal Card account within 120 calendar days from the lounge access date if multiple eligible UOB principal credit cards are used or if the access is utilised by a Supplementary Cardmember.
Effective 18 August 2026, each Cardmember may present only one (1) eligible UOB credit card per lounge visit, regardless of the number of eligible UOB credit cards held.
